Where city living meets suburban tranquillity

Greystar is delighted to introduce Griffith Wood, a new, purpose-built collection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom rental apartments on Dublin's prestigious Griffith Avenue. With the finest urban facilities in a parkland setting, Griffith Wood is where city life meets suburban tranquillity to give you the best of both worlds. Not only will residents benefit from a professional service, where all the homes are looked after by Greystar, but they will also enjoy exceptional quality apartments and access to a host of additional benefits. This is a community built around helping you enjoy a happy, healthy and productive lifestyle with concierge, gym and residents lounge. We provide a curated living experience for those looking to find new friends and neighbours, with our host of resident events throughout the year, all managed by a dedicated on-site team. Apartments are meticulously designed and furnished for modern living; spacious and bright, with high ceilings and large windows to increase natural light. The parkland setting with mature trees and on-site playground is a healthy distraction on your doorstep. Griffith Wood's on-site co-working space is open 24/7 and equipped with super-fast WiFi and a coffee station. There's also parking, secure bike storage and a postal room with secure parcel storage. All apartments are pet friendly and residents can choose from furnished or unfurnished options in an array of floorplans, many with views of the tree canopy.

Griffith Wood’s location on the longest tree-lined avenue in the Northern Hemisphere is as suited for commuting to and from the city centre as it is for enjoying relaxed suburban living. Griffith Wood is located on the prestigious Griffith Avenue, Dublin 9. While quiet and peaceful, the community is a vibrant one that’s well populated by local shops, schools, parks and recreational sporting facilities. All of which are just minutes away and can be reached on foot. The complex is also close to Dublin City Centre, Dublin City University, Fairview Park, Croke Park, the International Financial Services Centre (IFSC) and East Point Business Park, and is well serviced by bus and cycle routes. The DART line in Clontarf is a short walk away, while Dublin City Airport and the M1 and M50 motorways can be easily accessed, allowing you to explore Dublin, the counties of Ireland and further afield.
